fix [#9012](https://github.com/meta/docusaurus/issues/9012)

Fixed. The change makes code block languages case-insensitive in two places:

1. `packages/docusaurus-theme-classic/src/options.ts:316` — added a `PrismLanguage` Joi schema that lowercases values, applied to `prism.defaultLanguage` and `prism.additionalLanguages` items, so config values like `'PHP'`/`'pHp'` are normalized to `'php'` before being used anywhere (including `prism-include-languages` and webpack aliases).
